sections.content: Use familiar sequencing expressions to organise a travel narrative. Antes de + infinitive introduces an action that happens earlier, while después de + infinitive introduces an action that happens later. You can combine these with past and recent-experience forms: Antes de salir, preparamos las maletas. Después de llegar, hemos visitado la ciudad.

items.spanish: Antes de salir, preparamos las maletas.
items.english: Before leaving, we prepared the suitcases.

items.spanish: Después de llegar, visitamos la ciudad.
items.english: After arriving, we visited the city.

items.spanish: Antes de viajar, hemos preparado todo.
items.english: Before travelling, we have prepared everything.

items.spanish: Después de volver, hemos recordado el viaje.
items.english: After returning, we have remembered the trip.

sections.content: Keep the time frame clear. Use ir a + infinitive for a plan, the indefinido for a completed past event, and the perfecto for a recent experience connected to the present.
